verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox's own docs say it provides a real street address that meets business registration requirements in most states, and position it as an alternative to a home address and a P.O. Box. A customer testimonial describes using it to establish a business address. Missing for 10: any evidence it is accepted for bank KYC, explicit coverage of vendor forms, a list of the states where it does not qualify ("most states" only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
